text:
alex: heads up — we keep getting customer reports where the SDK surfaces a generic 5xx and the console shows 'degraded' but no clear hint whether it's a routing fallback, quota, or model failure. customers are confused.

priya: ugh. do we have distinct signals in telemetry for route fallback vs quota vs model OOM?

sam: we do, but they're fragmented. route_reason exists, but it's often null for legacy code paths. quota hits are in billing logs, model errors in runtime traces. stitching takes manual joins.

jordan: iirc the runtime returns `X-RW-ROUTE` header on fallback, and we emit `route_reason` tag, but SDKs drop unknown headers. we should standardize a client-visible enum.

lisa: proposal: introduce a compact client-visible reason header `X-Redwood-FailMode: ok|degraded|throttled|unavailable` + machine code `X-Redwood-Reason: <short-code>`. SDKs map to typed enums.

priya: love compact header. example?

sam: sure —
```
X-Redwood-FailMode: degraded
X-Redwood-Reason: routing_fallback_pool_full
```

alex: plus a `Retry-After` when appropriate for throttle. and we need console surfaces to show the full reason next to the request sample.

jordan: telemetry-wise, we should emit `route_origin` (primary|fallback), `route_variant` (model-v1|model-v1-quant), and `failmode` (degraded/throttled). sampling: low-overhead for p95/p99, full payload for 1% of requests.

lisa: SDK UX: map `degraded` -> warn in client logs + opt-in `on_degrade` callback. default console banner text should be: "Degraded response quality due to fallback — see route details" with link to runbook.

priya: what about user-facing messages in product? some customers want explicit quota messaging like "tenant budget exceeded" vs "system degraded". should that be in the header too?

sam: short-code approach lets us. e.g. `quota_exhausted_tenant` vs `quota_exhausted_global`. client apps can show a more helpful CTA for quota.

alex: question for rollout: we can't flip headers everywhere at once. plan: 1) runtime emits both old `route_reason` tag and new headers, 2) SDKs read new headers if present, fallback to old tags via response metadata, 3) console reads headers from sampled logs for human display. enable behind feature-flag `ff/transparent-failmodes`.

jordan: agree. add a telemetry migration plan: backfill last 30d of sampled logs to map old tag values to new short-codes so dashboards don't show gaps.

lisa: runbook copy suggestion for customer-facing page: "If you see 'Degraded' — the platform routed to a lower-capacity/compat model. Expect higher latency and some quality variance. Check route details and retry with lower concurrency or pin a model." short and actionable.

priya: also add console badge logic: green/yellow/red for OK/Degraded/Throttled with hover text from `X-Redwood-Reason`. and a link to billing if `quota_` prefix.

alex: ack. owners? runtime: sam + jordan. SDKs: lisa. console/dashboard: priya. docs & runbook: alex. I'll open RFC and tracker.

ops-bot: Ticket created: RW-3579 - "Client-visible failmode headers and console mapping" by alex — assigned: sam, jordan, lisa, priya. Priority: P2.

jordan: tiny nit — name the header `X-RW-FailMode` instead? shorter for proxies that have header length constraints.

lisa: fine with `X-RW-FailMode` as long as we document canonical long name.

alex: ok `X-RW-FailMode` / `X-RW-Reason`. RFC will include examples, sampling plan, rollout gates and unit tests. target: staged rollout next week behind ff.

priya: I'll update the dashboard mockups and add an example query to the deps workbook for cross-join.

sam: i'll scope runtime changes and list all legacy paths that need dual-emission. will post checklist by EOD.

alex: thanks — let's keep chatter to channel. please add any followups in RW-3579."
